title: SIDESTORY: WHAT THE FIRELIGHT CASTS RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: WHAT THE FIRELIGHT CASTS RERUN
DURATION: August 21, 2024, 10:00 - September 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: What the Firelight Casts event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Swamp In The Mists, Onsite]
Duration: August 21, 2024, 10:00 - August 31, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Ashes of Memories, Onsite]
Duration: August 21, 2024, 10:00 - August 31, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Search Warrant From the City Council]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Search Warrant From the City Council] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARD: [★★★★★: Puzzle], Reed's Cabin Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, [Manuscripts of Ballads], etc.
[River Valley Caravan]
DURATION: August 21, 2024, 10:00 - September 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Manuscripts of Ballads] by clearing event stages and completing [Search Warrant From the City Council] missions. [Manuscripts of Ballads] can be used to redeem items from [River Valley Caravan].
REWARDS: Puzzle's token, Reed's Cabin Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

The requirements to obtain certain medals for this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once logged in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Reed the Flame Shadow, Puzzle, and Harmonie will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Side Story] permanently from September 4, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – TO BLOOM FROM A DIM FLAME
DURATION: August 21, 2024, 10:00 – September 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [To Bloom From a Dim Flame], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting.
★★★★★★: Reed the Flame Shadow
★★★★★: Harmonie / Greyy the Lightningbearer

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting] that features the same Operators as the latest permanent [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: August 21, 2024, 10:00 - September 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
EPOQUE Collection - Amidst the Pieces for Puzzle
04 ICEFIELD MESSENGER COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: August 21, 2024, 10:00 - September 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Icefield Messenger Collection - Maiden for the Bright Night for Goldenglow
Icefield Messenger Collection - Untold Stories for Erato
Icefield Messenger Collection - Aftershow for Greyy the Lightningbearer
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – REED'S CABIN
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- What the Firelight Casts event rewards and redeemable (pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
Duration: August 21, 2024, 10:00 - September 4, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
